page.overview:
What is Gannis Ducain's starship?

The Nikto Gannis Ducain owned a starship which he operated around the world of Oskatoon during the New Republic Era.

Gannis Ducain's starship appeared in first issue of the comic miniseries Star Wars: Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon. The comic was written by Rodney Barnes, illustrated by Ramon Rosanas, and published by Marvel Comics
